data.name: Sirona Technologies
data.description: Sirona Technologies is a Belgium-based Direct Air Capture startup founded in 2023 by a former Tesla engineer and a thermodynamics PhD. The company develops modular solid-sorbent DAC units manufactured in Brussels and deployed globally, with captured CO₂ permanently stored via geological mineralization. Sirona has raised ~€6M seed funding and is building out a pilot plant in Kenya, with first commercial credit deliveries expected in 2026.
